summary: Iter46 retest of the 3 iter45 defects — ALL FIXED. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_polish_retest.py = 7/7 PASS. The reply endpoint's delivered/ok now mirror the send_email RETURN value: with mailer.send_email patched to {'status':'error',http:500}, {'status':'skipped','reason':'no_key'} and a raising mock, the handler returns HTTP-200-equivalent payload {persisted:true, delivered:false, ok:false}, the reply row on contact_messages has delivered:false and status='replied'; patched to {'status':'ok'} → delivered:true. HTTP guards still hold (401 no auth, 403 non-admin, 404 unknown msg_id, 400 short body <5, 400 body >6000, happy path 200 with full {ok,persisted,delivered,reply} contract + mongo persistence). Frontend: (1) AdminContact amber data-testid='reply-retry-badge-<id>' renders 'Saved · email retry pending' (bg-amber-100/text-amber-800) on the delivered:false seeded reply only; real send toasts 'Reply sent & delivered.'; with the POST /reply response stubbed to persisted:true/delivered:false the toast reads exactly "Saved — email delivery failed. We'll retry.". (2) ProPhotosUploader — the exact iter45 killer (4000x3000 noisy PNG, 35 MB) now compresses to a 373,420-char PATCH payload, server returns 200 and the thumbnail renders (slot index 2, first free slot after the 2 seeded Unsplash photos) — NO 400 rejection. (3) Regression: 2000x1500 noisy PNG compresses, PATCH 200, thumbnail added (4 total). (4) Truly uncompressible input (1600x1600 pure random noise, >1.1M chars even at q=40) now short-circuits: red toast 'pure_noise_1600.png is too detailed to fit under the 400 KB cap — try cropping or a smaller shot' fires immediately and ZERO PATCH requests are made. (5) Non-image .txt → toast "not_an_image.txt isn't an image — skipped", no PATCH.

issues: Sonner toasts render top-center and overlay the page heading ('Contact queue') and the market chips on /profile — cosmetic only, carried over from iter45

critical_code_review_comments: imageCompress.js now correctly gates on dataUrl.length with an integer quality ladder and returns a best-effort {ok:false} payload — good. Optional hardening: export the 400_000 limit from one shared module so the backend char cap and the client cap can't drift again.

For genuinely uncompressible photos the client only refuses; consider also stepping the long-edge cap down (1600 → 1200 → 900) before giving up, so noisy camera shots still upload instead of being rejected.

The amber retry badge / warning toast are still informational only — nothing actually retries the failed email; a background retry job or an admin 'resend' action would close the loop implied by 'We'll retry.'

The delivery-status matrix calls admin_router.admin_contact_reply in-process with mailer.send_email patched; all 4 scenarios MUST share one asyncio.run (motor binds to the first loop). Note toasts auto-dismiss in ~4s — poll every 500ms instead of a single long wait.
rca_of_the_issue: Both iter45 root causes are resolved: (1) admin_contact_reply now derives ok from res.get('status')=='ok' so the error/skipped statuses returned by the never-raising mailer produce delivered=false; (2) imageCompress.js measures the base64 data-URL character count against the same 400,000 limit the API enforces and walks integer qualities [85,75,65,55,45,40], returning {ok:false} best-effort so ProPhotosUploader can toast instead of sending a payload the server would 400.
